'''Incomplete article.''' The Japanese card face is shown. Fields awaiting verification are marked below.

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">リフト・チューブ</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-148o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">４名の乗客を運べる。屋内の移動要塞の位置カードにのみ配備／移動できる。人員なしでの移動が可能。戦闘およびフォース消耗へのリアクションとして、動ける範囲で移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">密閉型で、垂直水平方向に高速で移動する輸送シリンダー。宇宙ステーションや、大型艦で主に使用されている。反重力フィールドを使用。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Lift Tube.

'''Card text:''' May carry four passengers. May deploy or move only to interior sites of a mobile fortress. May move without personnel aboard. May move within range as a react to a battle or Force drain.

'''Lore:''' An enclosed transport cylinder that moves quickly both vertically and horizontally. Used mainly on space stations and capital ships. It uses an antigravity field.
